per_hop.query:
SELECT host.name, COUNT(show.id) AS total_shows_hosted
FROM television_shows AS show
JOIN show_hosts AS host ON show.host_id = host.id
JOIN tv_appearances AS appearance ON appearance.show_id = show.id
JOIN performers AS performer ON appearance.performer_id = performer.id
WHERE performer.name = 'Paul Melba' AND show.country = 'United Kingdom'
GROUP BY host.name
ORDER BY total_shows_hosted DESC;
